answer: An agent economy mitigates Sybil attacks using botanical spectrometry along a river corridor. Nodes authenticate by measuring narrow-band reflectance from wild yarrow adjacent to a surveyed stone relic. Verifiers check these spectral readings against local vegetative baselines, forcing attackers to deploy discrete hardware spectrometers and expend physical navigation energy per identity. However, shifting cloud cover alters ambient illumination, causing occasional false verification rejections.
